title: Resident Trust Fund Accounts: The Spare Amount of an Account
content:
**Definition.** The spare amount of a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account is the available balance, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount only.

The available balance is the account balance, which is the deposits, interest credits and returns on the account's ledger less its withdrawals, bill transfers and conveyances, less every deposit whose available date is after today, because a check deposit still on hold is not available.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Ledger to date | Amount |
|---|---|
| deposits | $3415.80 |
| interest credits | $2.37 |
| returns | $96.40 |
| withdrawals | $460.00 |
| bill transfers | $1972.15 |
| conveyances | none |
| account balance | $1082.42 |
| a family check deposited two days ago, available date still ahead | $150.00 |
| available balance and spare amount | **$932.42** |

A deposit whose available date is today is already available and is not taken off.
